**Reference period: December 2025** (`REF_DATE` = `2025-12`) — a monthly reference period, not a point-in-time snapshot.

From the rows for that period (British Columbia, Total - Gender, 15 years and over, seasonally adjusted):

| Series | Estimate (000s) | SE |
|---|---|---|
| Employment | 2,944.1 | 18.2 |
| Full-time | 2,340.0 | 20.1 |
| Part-time | 604.2 | 15.9 |
| Employment rate | 60.7% | 0.4 |

Two caveats on the "as-of" framing:

- The file only carries month granularity. This is Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey data (table 14-10-0287, vector `v2064701` for employment), where the underlying collection reference is the week containing the 15th of the month — but that week is not stated in the CSV itself, so treating it as "December 2025" is what the data supports.
- These are **seasonally adjusted** values, so each observation is a function of the surrounding series, not a standalone December measurement. It will revise when the seasonal adjustment is re-estimated.
